title: Restore, O Father! to Our Times Restore
description: Restore, O Father! to Our Times Restore in Tonic Solfa to ELLERS, doh is Ab: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 680 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “"And all that believed were together." Acts 4:44”, where the book credits them to Beard's Collection.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Tens (10.10.10.10), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ELLERS; any other Tens tune fits them as well.
underlay: Re-store, O Fa-ther! to our times re-store The peace which filled thine in-fant church of yore; Ere lust of power had sown the seeds of strife, And quenched the new born char-i-ties of life.

lines: Restore, O Father! to our times restore
The peace which filled thine infant church of yore;
Ere lust of power had sown the seeds of strife,
And quenched the new-born charities of life.
O never more may differing judgments part
From kindly sympathy a brother's heart;
But linked in one, believing thousands kneel,
And share with each the sacred joy they feel.
From soul to soul, quick as the sunbeam's ray,
Let concord spread one universal day;
And faith, by love lead all mankind to thee,
Parent of peace, and fount of harmony!

licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1853.
